content.content:
Licence check, applied by a reviewer reading the recorded nodes; nothing runs.

(1) Identity element, licensed by the prerequisite. The dependent's recorded requirement sentence has a dev host host an extension. Read the identity off the sentence — the name it gives what is hosted — and off uuutyrzs — the identifier that prerequisite records and the display form it records for it. Fail, naming the element and both readings, if the sentence attaches to the hosted extension an identity the prerequisite does not record. A name that reaches the recorded words is the same identity even when separators, case, spacing or an extension suffix differ, and one identity written in two registers is not a finding; two different names are. Fail, naming the gap, if no element of the sentence identifies what the host hosts: the edge then records no use to license.

(2) Attribution. What uuutyrzs records is an identity, nothing more. The otherwise present elements of the sentence — that the session is the Run Extension debug session, that it starts a host, that the repository is open in it, and that the host is given artefacts built from the current sources rather than stale ones — are the dependent's own recorded commitment. Do not fail them for lacking this prerequisite's support, and do not accept this prerequisite, or an identity the repository records elsewhere, as evidence for them. A contradicting element of that kind that offends another recorded prerequisite of the dependent is that edge's evaluation's finding and is not reported here.

(3) Freshness element, checked against the dependent's own record. The sentence's commitment is that what the host is given is built from the current sources before the host starts, never whatever was last built. Fail, naming the element, if the recorded commitment is dropped or reversed. Do not fail on wording, on which build tool or which artefacts are named, on how many are named, or on clause order: this clause reads a property of the subject's record, not its phrasing, and it is the subject that grounds it, not the prerequisite.

(4) No behaviour. This cell buys no licence to demand observables: the check does not read, run or require a launch configuration, a build script, a bundle, or a session, and it does not fail a requirement that a lawful rewording changed without changing what is decided.

(5) Placeholder. A placeholder, empty or clause-less recorded subject leaves the check with no subject to read: fail, naming the placeholder.
content.rationale: Derivation from the matrix, not a choice of convenience. uuutyrzs is ref "inline" with type "text" — a commitment in words — so it is the natural layer. usunynqx is ref "inline" with type "ears": a requirement sentence is constrained notation with a fixed grammar, so it is the structured layer. eval-matrix.md, row natural, column structured, sends this edge to evals/natural-to-structured.md: the gate form, whose whole check is licence — no element of the elaboration contradicts the parent, findings named at check time — and which forbids demanding observables, because a requirement sentence is still words and the strictness rule checks children in words for non-violation only. Nothing runs; content.ref is "inline" because this unit writes no repo path. depends_on is exactly [uuutyrzs], the edge this evaluation covers: usunynqx gains that prerequisite in this refine, and I4 asks the covering evaluation to evaluate the dependent and depend on the prerequisite. xtsnpqmr is deliberately absent: vxuwlrqr already covers the usunynqx -> xtsnpqmr use unchanged, and this node's teeth are the identity use; the licence over the prose prerequisite is not re-argued here. The attribution rule in clause (2) is what keeps the two claims apart — the identity the host hosts is licensed by this prerequisite, while the freshness of what the host is given is the subject's own commitment and is neither licensed by an identity nor satisfied by one — so the edge is not credited with a property its prerequisite does not state and the dependent is not failed for a property no identity prerequisite could carry. Clause (3) reads that second half as a property of the subject's record, which is what the words-layer strictness allows; it is not a second decision and states no rule of its own. Clause (1) names no identifier, display form, file or bundle in advance: which identity is at issue appears only in the check's output, so a lawful rewording of the sentence passes while a stale identity fails, and the identifiers the rename actually changes are pinned where the repository's artefacts carry them. Matrix gap, flagged for an entry: evals/natural-to-structured.md states a single licence clause and presumes one parent, saying nothing about how a requirement sentence with several recorded prerequisites distributes its elements among them, nor which prerequisite grounds which claim; this cell needed that attribution boundary to be decidable, and the boundary is stated in clause (2) rather than left to taste. That is a gap in the reference file, not a new layer, since both endpoints are the layers the matrix already has.
